description: Changes one WhatsApp number’s order settings, only the fields given: the delivery fee, the delivery zones, how long delivery takes (anywhere and per zone), the payment methods, AI order drafts, confirmation before shipping, the reminder hours, the deposit rule and the delivery messages (both Starter and up), and the Google Sheets sync. Each call needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the settings.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

delivery_time.description: How long delivery takes, as you tell customers, like "2 to 3 business days". Null or empty: not said.

cod.description: Cash on delivery is taken in this zone.

delivery_time.description: How long delivery takes, as you tell customers, like "2 to 3 business days". Null or empty: not said.

above.description: Asked of an order whose total is above this.

first_order.description: Asked of a customer’s first order.

id.description: The WhatsApp number, by its conn_ id.

account_id.description: A Google Sheets account (ca_ id) used on this number.

spreadsheet_id.description: Google’s id of the spreadsheet, as the picker gives it.

name: update_order_settings
title: Set a number’s order settings
